name: DNS registrar for eth.limo
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Vitalik Buterin stated on X that the DNS registrar for eth.limo has been attacked. He advised users to temporarily avoid accessing vitalik.eth.limo or any other eth.limo-related pages until official confirmation is given that the issue has been resolved and services are back to normal.
